## Q. I want to change the omikuji content

![](../../../../images/23_OmikujiEdit-1792765080714.webp)

- This setting is common to Comment Events, Timer Events, and Action Sets.
- You can change it under "Omikuji Settings" > Speech Bubble Content.
  - The following features can be used in the content.
  - [Evaluation Blocks](/core/ConfigEditor/sub/VariablePlaceholder.md)
  - [Placeholders](/core/ConfigEditor/sub/ContentPlaceholder.md)
